# BNL Community Fixes v2.4.2

Build preview stuck block fix and cleanup.

## Changes
- Build preview: fixed blocks becoming stuck and unbreakable when the server rejects or ignores a placement — rollback now defers correctly if ZoneManager isn't ready and immediately resolves accepted builds.
- Build preview: prediction timeout hardcoded to 3 seconds (removed user-configurable setting).
- Removed font replacement feature.
- Replay keybinds are now fully disabled when not launched via the replay launcher.
